tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'bum da pa bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ glegs bam bcu gcig pa/ bam po dang po/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind pa la gnas shing / sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge pa'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' pa dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nad yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rtog pa myed pa dpyod pa myed pa ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba

las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms la gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par dpyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa btang snyoms dang dran pas yongs su dag pa bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la mi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chud zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes med min skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bsam gtan gyi

pha rol tu phyin pa de la gnas nas/ myi g.yeng ba'i yid kyis sems can de dag la zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa yongs su gtong zhing / gzhan yang zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa'i legs pa yang rjod do/ /gzhan yang zang zing gi sbyin pa dang / chos kyi sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba de dag gi legs pa yang brjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su myi sngo'i/ gzhan du na sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pa'i sems 'dod chags dang ldan pa myi skyed/ sems zhe sdang dang ldan pa myi skyed/ sems gti mug dang ldan pa myi skyed/ sems 'tshe ba dang ldan pa myi skyed de gzhan du na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas/ rnam par spyod de/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su myi sngo'i/ gzhan du na sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo ste/

rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / gzugs la dbu ba lta bur rab tu rtog /tshor ba la chu bur lta bur rab tu rtog /'du shes la smyig rgyu lta bur rab tu rtog /'du byed la chu shing lta bur rab tu rtog/ rnam par shes pa la sgyu ma lta bur rab tu rtog ste/ de de ltar nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la so sor rtog cing snying po myed par 'du shes nye bar gnas pa yin te/ de de ltar so sor rtog pas de 'di snyam ste/ yan lag dang nying lag bcad gtubs kyang su la gcod/ su la gcad/ lus ni su'i lus/ tshor ba ni su'i tshor ba/ 'du shes ni su'i 'du shes/ 'du byed ni su'i 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa ni su'i rnam par shes pa snyam ste/ de de ltar so sor rtog pa'i tshe/ 'di snyam ste/ gang la spyo ba dang / bkyal ba byas na/ gnod sems skye ba de lta bu'i gshe ba yang gang zhig yod/ 'khyal pa yang gang zhig yod snyam ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas/ nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rtog pa myed pa dpyod pa myed pa ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms la gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa/ bde ba la rnam par dpyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa btang snyoms dang dran pas yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs shing gnas te/ de bsam gtan dang bsam gtan gyi yan lag de dag la yang mtshan mar myi 'dzin to/ /de de ltar mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems dang ldan pas/ rdzu 'phrul rnam pa du ma nyams su myong bar byed do/ sa chen po 'di yang rab tu g.yo bar byed do/ /gcig tu gyur cing mang por 'gyur ro/ /mang por gyur cing gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /snang ba dang myi snang ba yang nyams su myong bar byed do/ /rtsig pa las thal ba dang / ra ba las thal ba dang / ri las thal bar thogs pa med par 'gro ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bya

ba bzhin no/ /nam mkha' la yang 'gro ste/ dper na 'dab chags bya bzhin no/ /sa la yang gyen du 'byung ba dang / 'og tu 'dzul ba byed de/ dper na chu la bya ba bzhin no/ /chu la yang 'bying ba med par 'gro ste/ dper na sa la bya ba bzhin no/ /du bar 'thul zhing myer 'bar te/ dper na mye'i phung po chen po bzhin no/ /nyi ma dang zla ba 'di dag 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che la/ 'di ltar mthu che zhing dbang che ba dag kyang lag pas byugs shing / tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar du lus kyis dbang sgyur ro/ /de lha'i rna ba rnam par dag pa mi las 'das pas lha dang mi'i sgra nye ba 'am/ ring yang rung ste/ thos so/ /des sems can pha rol dang / gang zag pha rol gyi sems sems kyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ 'dod chags dang ldan pa'i sems la/ 'dod chags dang ldan pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems la/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i sems la/ zhe sdang dang ldan pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zhe sdang dang bral ba'i sems la/ zhe sdang dang bral ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /gti mug dang ldan pa'i sems la/ gti mug dang ldan pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /gti mug dang bral ba'i sems la/ gti mug dang bral ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sred pa dang ldan pa'i sems la/ sred pa dang ldan pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /sred pa dang bral ba'i sems la/ sred pa dang bral ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du

rab tu shes so/ /nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i sems la/ nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nye bar len pa myed pa'i sems la/ nye bar len pa myed pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /kun nas 'dus pa'i sems la kun nas 'dus pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par 'phros pa'i sems la rnam par 'phros pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rgya chung ba'i sems la/ rgya chung ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rgya che ba'i sems la/ rgya che ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /yangs pa'i sems la yangs pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /tshad med pa'i sems la tshad med pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems la mnyam par bzhag pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems la/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par grol ba'i sems la/ rnam par grol ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rnam par ma grol ba'i sems la/ rnam par ma grol ba'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zag pa dang bcas pa'i sems la/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zag pa myed pa'i sems la/ zag pa myed pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i sems la/ nyon mongs

pa dang bcas pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /nyon mongs pa myed pa'i sems la/ nyon mongs pa myed pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /bla na yod pa'i sems la/ bla na yod pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /bla na med pa'i sems la/ bla na myed pa'i sems zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /de ni sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du ma rjes su dran te/ sems gcig kyang rjes su dran pa nas/ sems brgya'i bar du yang rjes su dran no/ /nyi ma gcig kyang rjes su dran pa nas/ nyi ma brgya'i bar du yang rjes su dran no/ /zla ba gcig rjes su dran pa nas/ zla ba brgya'i bar du yang rjes su dran no/ /lo gcig rjes su dran pa nas/ lo brgya'i bar du yang rjes su dran no/ /bskal pa gcig rjes su dran pa nas/ bskal pa brgya'i bar du yang rjes su dran no/ /bskal pa brgya phrag du ma yang rjes su dran no/ /bskal pa stong phrag du ma yang rjes su dran no/ /bskal pa brgya stong phrag du ma yang rjes su dran no/ /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma yang rjes su dran te/ /bdag ni de lta bu zhig na 'dug 'dug ste/ mying ni 'di zhes bya/ rus ni 'di zhes bya/ rigs ni 'di zhes bya/ kha zas ni 'di lta bu zhig za za/ yun ni 'di srid cig tu 'dug 'dug /tshe'i mtha' ni 'di tsam cig tu gyur te/ de ltar bdag de nas shi 'phos nas/ che ge mo zhig tu skyes so zhes bya ba nas/ de nas shi 'phos nas ni 'dir skyes so zhes bya ba'i bar du rnam pa dang bcas/ gtan tshigs dang bcas/ de na rtags dang bcas par bdag dang gzhan gyi sngon gyi gnas rnam pa du mar rjes su dran no/ /de ni lha'i myig rnam par dag pa/ myi las 'das pas sems can 'chi 'pho ba dang /

skye ba dang kha dog sdug pa dang / myi sdug pa dang / bzang ba dang / ngan pa dang / ngan song na gnas pa dang / bde 'gro na gnas pa dag kyang rab tu shes te/ sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa/ ngag gis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyis ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa 'phags pa rnams la skur pa 'debs pa/ log par lta ba rnams te/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen kyis lus zhig nas ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba dag du skye'o/ /sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ ngag gis legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyis legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa la skur pa myi 'debs pa/ yang dag par lta ba rnams te/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen kyis lus zhig nas/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha'i nang du skye bar 'gyur ro zhes bya bar rab tu shes te/ de ltar phyogs bcu kun kyi 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa dag gi 'gro ba drug tu gtogs pa rnams kyi skye ba dang / 'chi 'pho ba yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ de mngon par shes pa lnga po de dag la rab tu gnas nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur bya ba dang / yongs su dri ba dang / yongs su zhu ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bstsags pa dang / sems can yongs su smyin par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang nyan thos kyi sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su myi sngo'o/ gzhan du na sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas shing / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo zhing / ci nas kyang gang yongs su

sngo ba dang / ci yongs su sngo ba dang / gang la yongs su bsngo ba'i blo rnam pa gsum du myi 'gyur ba de ltar yongs su sngo ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind pa la gnas shing / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rold tu phyin pa la gnas shing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas pas/ gzugs myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs so/ /myig myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba myi dmyigs so/ /sna myi dmyigs so/ /lce myi dmyigs so/ /lus myi dmyigs so/ /yid myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myi dmyigs so/ /sgra myi dmyigs so/ /dri myi dmyigs so/ /ro myi dmyigs so/ /reg myi dmyigs so/ /chos myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa mi dmigs so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i

'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs so/ /sa'i khams myi dmyigs so/ /chu'i khams myi dmyigs so/ /mye'i khams mi dmigs so/ /rlung gi khams myi dmyigs so/ /nam mkha'i khams myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs so/ /mying dang gzugs myi dmyigs so/ /skye mched drug myi dmyigs so/ /reg pa myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba mi dmyigs so/ /sred pa myi dmyigs so/ /len pa myi dmyigs so/ /srid pa myi dmyigs so/ /skye ba myi dmyigs so/ /rga shi myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myi

dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po lnga myi dmyigs so/ /stobs lnga myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /tshad med pa bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad myi dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad myi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs so/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /rang byang chub myi dmyigs so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas kyi khams myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas kyi khams myi dmyigs so/ /de ltar myi dmyigs pas na/ mngon par 'du myi byed do/ /mngon par 'du myi byed pas na/ skye bar myi byed/ 'gag par myi byed do/ /

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung ma byung yang rung ste/ chos rnams kyi chos kyi gnas nyid de ni gnas pa ste/ chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gnas pa'i phyir/ de myi skye myi 'gag pas/ de g.yeng ba myed pa'i sems dang ldan par rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang ldan pa'i yid la bya ba dang ma bral ba yin te/ rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad stong pa'o zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad stong pa'o zhes bgyi bar yang dag par rjes su mthong ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ nang stong pa nyid la nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid la phyi stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid la phyi nang stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid la chen po stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid la don

dam pa stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid la 'dus byas stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid la rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid la chos thams cad stong pa nyid ces bya bar mi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ces bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de stong pa nyid bcu bzhi po de dag la gnas shing / gzugs stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'du shes stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /myig stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /sna stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lce stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lus stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /yid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi

dmyigs so/ /sgra stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /dri stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /ro stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /reg stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /chos stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lce'i

'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /sa'i khams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /chu'i khams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /me'i khams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rlung gi khams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /nam mkha'i khams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /ma rig pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'du byed stong zhes bya ba 'am/ mi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par shes pa stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /mying dang gzugs stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /skye mched drug stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /reg pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /tshor ba stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /sred pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /len pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /srid pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ mi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /skye ba stong zhes bya ba 'am/ mi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rga shi stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol

tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ mi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /nang stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ mi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /phyi stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid stong pa zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ mi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /chen po stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmigs so/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba

'am/ /myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /dbang po lnga stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /stobs lnga stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi stong zhes bya ba 'am/ mi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan bzhi stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /tshad myed pa bzhi stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /gzungs kyi

sgo rnams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi stong zhes bya ba 'am/ mi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /snying rje chen po stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /rang byang chub stong zhes bya ba'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar mi dmigs so/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'dus byas kyi khams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs so/ /'dus ma byas kyi khams stong zhes bya ba 'am/ myi stong zhes bya bar myi dmyigs te/ de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyod cing zas sam/ skom mam/ bzhon pa'am/ gos sam/ me tog gam/ phreng ba'am/ spos sam/ byug pa'am/ mal cha'am/ gnas sam/ 'tsho ba'am/ yo byad dam/ myi'i yo byad gzhan gang yang rung ba sbyin pa gang dang gang gtong yang des sbyin pa de stong pa zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mthong ngo / /gang yongs su gtong ba dang / gang la yongs su gtong ba de yang stong pa zhes bya bar yang dag par rjes su mthong ste/ de la 'jungs pa'i sems sam/ yongs su

'dzin pa'i sems kyi skabs myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du rnam par rtog pa de dag thams cad med de/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa la ji ltar 'jungs pa'i thugs sam/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i thugs mi mnga' ba de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa la yang 'jungs pa'i sems sam/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i sems skye ba myed do/ /'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ston pa'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sems kyi go skabs myi 'byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar des nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa gang du yongs su sngo ba de lta bu'i nyan thos kyi sa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa yang myi dmyigs/ sems de yang myi dmyigs te/ de sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du bdag gis kyang srog gcod pa spangs pa yin/

gzhan yang srog gcod pa spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ srog gcod pa spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis srog gcod pa spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang ma byin par len pa spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang ma byin par len pa spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ ma byin par len pa spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis ma byin par len pa spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis 'dod pas log par g.yem pa spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang brdzun du smra ba spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang brdzun du smra ba spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ brdzun du smra ba spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis brdzun du smra ba spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang phra ma spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang phra ma spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ phra ma spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis phra ma spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang zhe gcod pa'i tshig spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang zhe gcod pa'i tshig spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ zhe gcod pa'i tshig spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis zhe gcod pa'i tshig spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang tshig kyal pa spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang tshig kyal pa spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ tshig kyal pa spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa

yin/ gzhan gang gis tshig kyal pa spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang chags sems spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang chags sems spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ chags sems spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis chags sems spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang gnod sems spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang gnod sems spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ gnod sems spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis gnod sems spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin/ bdag gis kyang log par lta ba spangs pa yin/ gzhan yang log par lta ba spong ba la yang dag par skul ba yin/ log par lta ba spong ba'i legs pa rjod pa yin/ gzhan gang gis log par lta ba spangs pa de dag gi legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar byed pa yin te/ tshul khrims des nyan thos sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos gang la yang chags par mi 'gyur na/ gzhan man chad lta ci smos te/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / rjes su mthun pa'i bzod pa skyes te/ de 'di snyam du 'di la chos gang yang skye ba'am/ 'gag pa'am/ 'byung ba'am/ 'jig pa'am/ 'chi ba'am/ gshe ba'am/

'khyal ba'am/ gcad pa'am/ gtub pa'am/ brdeg pa myed do snyam pas de la sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du gal te sems can thams cad drung du lhags nas spyos te/ bkyal tam/ rdo dbyug gis brdegs sam/ mtshon gyis btab ste bcad gtubs kyang de la 'di snyam ste/ kye ma chos rnams kyi chos nyid 'di ni ngo mtshar che ste/ 'di la chos gang la yang spyo ba'am/ bkyal ba'am/ bcad pa'am/ gtub pa'am/ brdeg pa'am/ bcing ba myed do snyam ste/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi la gnas te/ thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pas/ lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus bskyed de/ 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gam/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya 'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams stong ngam/ 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong ngam/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya'am/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba stong ngam/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya phrag stong ngam/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong dag du song ste/ sems can rnams la chos ston cing / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la rab tu 'god do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rab tu 'god do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu

phyin pa la rab tu 'god do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rab tu 'god do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rab tu 'god do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rab tu 'god do/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad la rab tu 'god do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la rab tu 'god do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid la rab tu 'god do/ /rang byang chub la rab tu 'god do/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la rab tu 'god do/ /de yang ci nas kyang 'dus byas kyi khams la rab tu bkod pa yang ma yin/ 'dus ma byas kyi khams la rab tu bkod pa yang ma yin pa de ltar rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma gtogs par nyan thos kyi ting nge 'dzin tam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin tam/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang rung ste/ ting nge 'dzin gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad la snyoms par 'jug ste/ ting nge 'dzin de dag la gnas shing / rnam par thar pa brgyad la lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang myi mthun par snyoms par 'jug cing rnam par ldang ngo / /brgyad gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po gzugs can gyis gzugs rnams mthong ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa dang po'o/ /nang gzugs myed pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams mthong ba 'di ni rnam par thar pa gnyis pa'o/ /bzang bar mos pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa gsum pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes rnams yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bzhi pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes te/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa lnga pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad med pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa drug pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad med pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa bdun pa'o/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes dang / tshor ba 'gog pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas pa 'di ni rnam par thar pa brgyad pa ste/ de ltar na rnam par thar pa brgyad po 'di dag la lugs dang mthun pa dang / /lugs dang myi mthun par snyoms par 'jug cing rnam par ldang ngo / /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang mi mthun par snyoms par 'jug cing rnam par ldang ste/ dgu gang zhe na/ rab 'byor

'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rtog pa myed pa/ dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms su gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis de la dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang / yid mi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas bde ba yang myed sdug bsngal ba yang myed pa btang snyoms dang dran pas yongs su dag pa bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur cing / sna tshogs kyi 'du shes yid la myi byed pas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas so zhes te/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so zhes rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ chung zad ma yod do zhes chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs

te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de rnam pa thams cad du 'du shes med 'du shes myed myin skye mched las yang dag par 'das te/ /'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /de ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu po de dag la lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang mi mthun par snyoms par 'jug cing rnam par ldang ngo / /de rnam par thar pa brgyad po de dag dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu po de dag rnam par phye zhing seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di la snyoms par 'jug go/ ting nge 'dzin de la gnas nas/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang myi mthun pa la so sor rtog go /de la yan lag bcu gnyis gang dag ce na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ma rig pa'i rkyen kyis 'du byed ces so sor rtog go /'du byad kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa zhes so sor rtog go /rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis mying dang gzugs zhes so sor rtog go /mying dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug ces so sor rtog go /skye mched drug gi rkyen kyis reg pa zhes so sor rtog go /reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba zhes so sor rtog go /tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa zhes so sor rtog go /sred pa'i rkyen kyis len pa zhes so sor rtog go /len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa zhes so sor rtog go /srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba zhes so sor rtog go /skye ba'i rkyen gyis rga shi zhes so sor rtog go /rga shi'i rkyen gyis mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid myi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa la so sor rtog par byed cing / 'di ltar sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' shig po 'di 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /rga shi myed na

mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid myi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' shig po rnams 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog cing / skye ba med na rga shi 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so sor rtog go /srid pa myed na skye ba 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /len pa myed na srid pa 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /sred pa med na len pa 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /tshor ba myed na sred pa 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /reg pa myed na tshor ba 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /skye mched drug myed na reg pa 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /mying dang gzugs med na skye mched drug 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /rnam par shes pa myed na mying dang gzugs 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /'du byed med na rnam par shes pa 'byung bar myi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /ma rig pa med na 'du byed 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog cing / de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' shig po 'di 'gag par 'gyur ro zhes so sor rtog go /de ltar na rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis po lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang myi mthun pa la so sor rtog cing / dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sngo bar byed do/ /de yang ci lta bu zhig sngo bar byed pa dang / ci ltar bsngo bar bya ba dang / gang tu bsngo bar bya ba gsum gyi blo myi 'byung ba de ltar sngo bar byed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas nas/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge

'dzin seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa de gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ /'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa dpyod pa dang bcas pa dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan dang bo las langs nas/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gnyis pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gsum pa las langs nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan bzhi pa las langs nas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas chung zad med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las langs nas 'du shes myed 'du shes myed min skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /'du shes myed 'du shes med myin skye mched las langs nas 'gog pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'du shes med 'du shes med myin skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched las langs nas/ chung zad med pa'i skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched las langs nas/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug go/

bsam gtan bzhi pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gsum pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gnyis pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug ste/ de seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'di rnam par smyin par byas nas/ thod rgal kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug go /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin thod rgal gang zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan dang po las langs nas/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan gsum pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa las langs nas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /chung zad med pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la nye

bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan dang po las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gnyis pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gsum pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan bzhi pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /chung zad myed pa'i skye

mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'du shes med 'du shes med myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'du shes med 'du shes med myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems su byed do/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las/ 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems la gnas so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las/ 'du shes myed 'du shes med myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug go /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems la gnas so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /chud zad myed pa'i skye mched las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems la gnas so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems la gnas so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la snyoms par 'jug go /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems la gnas so/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan bzhi pa

las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems su byed do/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las/ bsam gtan gsum pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gsum pa las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems su byed do/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan gnyis pa las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems su byed do/ /mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems las/ bsam gtan dang po la snyoms par 'jug go /bsam gtan dang po las langs nas/ mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i sems su byed do/ /de thod rgal gyi ting nge 'dzin de la gnas shing / chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid rjes su thob par byed de/ rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas shing / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su 'dzin to/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u lnga bcu gnyis so// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ /bam po gnyis pa/ /tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ gang thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan pa de/ yun ring po ji srid cig nas yang dag par zhugs pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ de ni bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig grangs myed pa nas yang dag par zhugs pa yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ gang thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan pa

des/ sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bsnyen bkur ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des ni sangs rgyas gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bsnyen bkur bar rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan pa des/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ci zhig bskrun pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa des/ yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa'i/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bya ba de lta bu gang yang med do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bya ba de lta bu gang yang myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bya ba de lta bu gang yang myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bya ba de lta bu gang yang myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bya ba de lta bu gang yang myed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i bya ba de lta bu gang yang med do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan pa de dag ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems

dpa' chen po thabs mkhas pa de lta bu dang ldan pa de dag ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni gling bzhir/ las byed cing gling bzhi'i rjes su 'gro'o/ /gling bzhi'i rjes su 'brang ngo / /rab 'byor de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang pha rol tu phyin pa lngar las byed cing / pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i rjes su 'gro'o/ /pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i rjes su 'brang ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral na/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying 'thob bo/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral na/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying myi 'thob bo/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang bral na/ rin po che sna bdun gyis 'khor los sgyur ba'i ming mi 'thob bo/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral na/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying myi 'thob bo/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ khyim thab myed pa'i bud myed rnams ni/ 'phyon ma rnams kyis tshugs par sla ba yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang bral na/ bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis tshugs par sla ba yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ khyim thab dpa' bos shin tu bsrungs pa'i bud myed shin tu phun sum tshogs pa'i khyim na 'dug pa ni/ 'phyon ma rnams kyis myi tshugs pa yin no/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral na/ bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis myi tshugs pa yin no/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ g.yul du 'gro ba'i skyes bu go cha tshang bar gyon pa mtshon cha thams cad thogs pa ni g.yul ngo na 'dug pa'i tshe/ rgyal po zla 'am/ phyir rgol ba dang /

dgra rnams kyis thub par dka'o/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ma bral na/ bdud dam bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams dang / gang zag lhag pa'i nga rgyal can nam/ byang chub sems dpa' gdol pa rnams kyis kyang thub par dka'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la khams kyi rgyal po yod pa rnams ni nang nub nang nub cing rim gro bya ba'i don du drung du 'ong ngo / /rab 'byor de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su zin na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang na ba der 'dong ngo / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chu klung gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad ni chu klung chen po gang gā gang na ba der 'dong ngo / /de dag chu klung gang gā dang 'grogs shing rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du 'dong do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su zin na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang na ba der 'dong ngo / /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu'i lag pa g.yas pa ni dgos pa thams cad byed do/ /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang de bzhin du blta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga ni lag pa g.yon pa ji lta ba bzhin du blta'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ chu klung phra mo rnams kyi chu dang chu klung chen po rnams kyi chu gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyang / rgya mtsho chen por phyin na 'di lta ste/ lan tsha'i ror ro gcig par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga yang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su zin na/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du phyin pa'i tshe/ 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ngor ro gcig par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/

'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i mdun du ni/ 'khor lo rin po che 'gro zhing 'dug ste/ gang du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po zas kyi don du 'dug par gyur pa der 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i dpung gi tshogs thams cad yongs su tshim par byed cing 'khor lo rin po che de dag gnas nas g.yo ba myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su bkri ba yin te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang na ba der 'dong ste/ /der gnas so/ /der gnas par gyur nas kyang gnas de las myi 'da' 'o/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che de dang / blon po rin po che de dang / khyim bdag rin po che de dang / bud myed rin po che de dang / nor bu rin po che de dang / glang po rin po che de dang / rta rin po che de dag ni dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'i mdun du 'dong ngo / /rab 'byor de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag gi mdun du 'gro ste/ mdun du song nas kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang na ba der gnas par 'gyur te/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'di snyam du bdag gi phyi bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'brang ngo snyam du myi sems so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'di snyam du bdag gi phyi bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'brang ngo snyam du myi sems so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'di snyam du bdag gi phyi bzhin du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'brang ngo snyam du myi sems so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'di snyam du bdag gi phyi bzhin du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'brang ngo snyam du myi sems so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'di snyam du bdag gi phyi bzhin du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'brang ngo snyam du myi sems so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu

phyin pa yang 'di snyam du bdag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes su 'brang ngo snyam du mi sems so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang 'di snyam du bdag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes su 'brang ngo snyam du mi sems so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang 'di snyam du bdag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes su 'brang ngo snyam du myi sems so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang 'di snyam du bdag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes su 'brang ngo snyam du mi sems so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang 'di snyam du bdag ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rjes su 'brang ngo snyam du myi sems so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag gi rang bzhin ni de yin te/ ci'ang nus pa myed pa ngo bo nyid kyis stong zhing gso ba ste/ smyig rgyu lta bu'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis stong pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'di snyam du kye ma 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni/ sems phyin ci log tu gyur pa ste/ de dag ni thabs la mi mkhas pas/ 'khor ba nas yongs su gdon par myi nus kyis/ ma la bdag gis sems can de dag gi don du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la

spyad par bya'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya'o snyam nas/ de sems can de dag gi don du phyi nang gi dngos po rnams yongs su gtong ste/ de yongs su gtong ba'i tshe 'di snyam ste/ bdag gis gang yang yongs su ma gtang ba myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dngos po 'di dag ni bdag nyid 'jig pa'o snyam ste/ rab 'byor de ltar yongs su rtog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de sems can de dag nyid kyi don du tshul khrims ngan pa'i skabs myi 'byed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar da 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs la srog gcod pa byed pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun gyi tshig smra ba dang / phra ma can du 'gyur ba dang / zhe gcod pa'i tshig smra ba dang / tshig kyal pa can du 'gyur ba dang / chags sems can du 'gyur ba dang / gnod sems su byed pa dang / log par lta ba can du 'gyur ba dang / yul la smon pa dang / lhar smon pa dang / tshangs par smon pa dang / nyan thos kyi sar smon pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sar smon pa 'di ni bdag tshul dang myi 'dra'o snyam ste/ rab 'byor de ltar yongs su rtog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de sems can de dag nyid kyi don du tshig rtsub pa dang / brlang bas rtag tu spyos shing / brgyad kyang 'khrug pa'i sems myi skyed/ rdo dbyug dang / bong ba dang / mtshon gyis btab cing bsnun pa dang / lus kyi yan

lag gshags sam/ yan lag dang nying lag bcad kyang zhe sdang gi sems mi skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni sgra thams cad sgra brnyan lta bur yongs su rtog go /gzugs thams cad dbu ba lta bur yongs su rtog go /rab 'byor de ltar yongs su rtog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de sems can de dag nyid kyi don du dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su btsal ba'i phyir/ le lo'i sems mi skyed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni 'di snyam du sems te/ mtho ris su skye ba'ang le lo can gyis rnyed par dka' na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lta ci smos kyis/ de bas na bdag gis nam bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du brtson 'grus brtsam par bya'o/ /rtag tu brtson pa mi 'dor bar bya'o snyam ste/ rab 'byor de ltar yongs su rtog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de sems can de dag nyid kyi don du sems myi 'khrugs pa yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni 'di snyam du sems te/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan du skye ba'ang sems 'khrugs pas rnyed par dka' na/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub lta ci smos kyis/ de bas na bdag gis nam bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du bdag gis sems ma 'khrugs par bya'o snyam ste/ rab 'byor de ltar yongs su rtog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /de sems can de dag nyid kyi don du nam bla na myid pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du/ nam yang shes rab

dang bral bar myi 'gyur te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni 'di snyam du sems te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la ma zhugs par rnam pa gzhan gyis sems can yongs su smyin par bya bar myi nus kyis/ de bas na bdag gis shes rab 'chal pa dang ldan pa'i sems 'ga' tsam yang bskyed par myi bya'o snyam ste/ rab 'byor de ltar yongs su rtog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni sems can rnams kyi don du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la tha dad pa ma mchis na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ji skad du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i rab ces bgyi/ gtso bo zhes bgyi/ mchog ces bgyi/ dam pa zhes bgyi/ phul zhes bgyi/ gya nom pa zhes bgyi/ bla na med pa zhes bgyi gong na myed pa zhes bgyi/ mnyam pa med pa zhes bgyi/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rab 'byor pha rol tu phyin pa rnams la ni/ rnam pa tha dad pa gang yang myed de/ gal te shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed na ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag gis kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying 'thob par myi 'gyur te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten na/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag gis kyang pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ lus rnam pa tha dad pa rnams ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi drung du phyin na/ kha dog gcig tu 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten na yang / pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag gis pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying 'thob par 'gyur te/ de dag kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du phyin na 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi kha dog tu kha dog gcig par 'gyur te/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /

'di ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'di ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes bya ba'i khyad par gang yang myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag la ngo bo nyid myed pas/ de'i phyir khyad par myed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar chos gang la yang khyad par ma mchis la bye brag ma mchis na/ rjes su thob par 'gyur ba ni gang zhig mchis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ci'i slad du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po de dag gi rab ces bgyi/ gtso bo zhes bgyi/ mchog ces bgyi/ dam pa zhes bgyi/ phul zhes bgyi/ gya nom pa zhes bgyi/ bla na med pa zhes bgyi/ gong na med pa zhes bgyi/ mnyam pa myed pa zhes bgyi/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ don rjes su thob par bya ba la/ chos gang la yang bye brag dang khyad par myed de/ 'on kyang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad dang brdar bya na/ sems can rnams 'khor ba las yongs su gdon pa'i don du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang yod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yod do/ /sems can de dag la yang skye ba myed/ 'chi ba myed 'pho ba myed 'byung ba myed de/ sems can med pas/ chos thams cad myed par rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor rnam grangs des na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag gi rab ces bya/ gtso bo zhes bya/ mchog ces bya/ dam pa zhes bya/ phul zhes bya/ gya nom pa zhes bya/ bla na med pa zhes bya/ gong

na myed pa zhes bya/ mnyam pa myed pa zhes bya/ myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ste/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi bud med gang ji snyed pa de dag gi nang na bud med rin po che ni rab ces bya/ gtso bo zhes bya/ mchog ces bya/ dam pa zhes bya/ phul zhes bya/ gya nom pa zhes bya/ bla na med pa zhes bya/ gong na med pa zhes bya/ mnyam pa myed pa zhes bya/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba bzhin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rab ces bgyi ba dang / gtso bo zhes bgyi ba dang / mchog ces bgyi ba dang / dam pa zhes bgyi ba dang / phul zhes bgyi ba dang / gya nom pa zhes bgyi ba dang / bla na med pa zhes bgyi ba dang / gong na myed pa zhes bgyi ba dang / mnyam pa myed pa zhes bgyi ba dang / myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa zhes bgyi ba de ci las dgongs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni/ dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su bzung zhing myi gnas pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gang na ba der gnas par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos gang yang yongs su 'dzin pa 'am/ gtong ba mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni ma yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chos gang yang yongs su 'dzin pa'am/ gtong ba myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad yongs su bzung ba myed pa dang / btang ba myed pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos thams cad myi 'dzin myi gtong ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'du shes yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'du byed yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rnam par shes pa yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni myig yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rna ba yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sna yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni lce yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni lus yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gzugs yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sgra yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dri yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ro yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni reg yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chos yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pa yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu

phyin pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sa'i khams yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chu'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni me'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rlung gi khams yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni nam mkha'i khams yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rnam par shes pa'i khams yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ma rig pa yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'du byed yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rnam par shes pa yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni mying dang gzugs yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni skye mched drug yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni reg pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshor ba yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sred pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni len pa yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni srid pa yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni skye ba yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rga shi yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa

ni nang stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni phyi stong pa nyid yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chen po stong pa nyid yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su mi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin mi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su mi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yongs su myi 'dzin myi gtong ngo / /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa
