rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na chen po stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na don dam pa stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na 'dus byas stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na rang bzhin stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na chos thams cad stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa

bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na mngon par shes pa drug rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na ting nge 'dzin thams cad rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na gzungs kyi sgo thams cad rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na myi 'jigs pa bzhi rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na byams pa chen po rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na snying rje chen po rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji

ltar na dgra bcom pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na rang byang chub rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags/ ji ltar na bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spong ba rnam par bsgom pa bsgom pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa lags// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bdun pa/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byord 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ gzugs dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /tshor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'du byed dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rnam par shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myig dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rna ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sna dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lce dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lus dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /yid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /gzugs dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sgra dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dri dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /

ro dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /reg dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /chos dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sgom mo/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sgom mo/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sgom mo/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sa'i khams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /chu'i khams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /mye'i khams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rlung gi khams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /nam

mkha'i khams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sgom mo/ /ma rig pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'du byed dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rnam par shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /mying dang gzugs dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /skye mched drug dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /reg pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /tshor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sred pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /len pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /srid pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /skye ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rga shi dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /blang ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dor ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bsam gtan dang po dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bsam gtan gsum pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /byams pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /snying rje dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dga' ba dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /btang snyoms dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi

snyoms par 'jug pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /chos rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /gtong ba rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lha rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /skyo ba rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'chi ba rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lus kyi rnam pa rjes su dran pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myi rtag pa'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bdag myed pa'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myi sdug pa'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bdag gi 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sems can gyi 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /srog gi 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /skye ba'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /gso ba'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /skyes bu'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /gang zag gi 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /shed can gyi 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi

sgom mo/ /shed bdag gi 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /byed pa po'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /tshor ba po'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /shes pa po'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /mthong ba po'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rtag pa'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bde ba'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sdug pa'i 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bdag gi 'du shes dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dbang po rnams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /stobs rnams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lam dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sgom mo/ /smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rtog pa dang bcas dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rtog pa myed la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rtog pa myed cing dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /

sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lam 'phags pa'i bden pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sdug bsngal shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /kun 'byung ba shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'gog pa shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lam shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /zad pa shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myi skye ba shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /chos shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rjes su 'gro ba shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /kun rdzob shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'dris pa shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sgra ji bzhin shes pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /nang stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /phyi stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /chen po stong pa nyid dngos

po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sgom mo/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /mngon par shes pa drug dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /byams pa chen po dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /snying rje chen po dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dngos po yod

ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sgom mo/ /dgra bcom pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rang byang chub dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dngos po yod ces bya bar mi sgom mo/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa dngos po yod ces bya bar myi sgom mo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor dngos po'i 'du shes can la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la nang stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la phyi stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la phyi nang stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la stong pa nyid stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la chen po stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la don dam pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la 'dus byas stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes

can la mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la rang bzhin stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la chos thams cad stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la mngon par shes pa drug bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la ting nge 'dzin thams cad bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la gzungs kyi sgo thams cad bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la myi 'jigs pa bzhi bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la byams pa chen po bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la snying rje chen po bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos

po'i 'du shes can la phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la dgra bcom pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la rang byang chub bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid bsgom pa med do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid bsgom pa myed do/ /dngos po'i 'du shes can la bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spong ba bsgom pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dngos po la 'di ni bdag go zhes bya bar mtha' gnyis la chags te/ sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir

myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spang ba la/ 'di ni bdag go zhes bya bar mtha' gnyis la chags par gyur pas/ gang mtha' gnyis la chags pa de la ni thar pa myed de/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor dngos po'i 'du shes can la ni/ sbyin pa yang myed/ tshul khrims kyang myed/ bzod pa yang myed/ brtson 'grus kyang myed/ bsam gtan yang myed/ shes rab kyang myed/ lam yang myed/ ye shes kyang myed/ 'thob pa yang myed/ mngon par rtogs pa yang myed/ mthun pa'i bzod pa yang med/ gzugs kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ tshor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'du byed kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rnam par shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ mig kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rna ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sna yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lce yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lus kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ yid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ gzugs kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ sgra yang yongs su shes pa myed/ dri yang yongs su shes pa myed/ ro yang yongs su shes pa myed/ reg kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ chos kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ myig gi rnam par shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sna'i rnam par shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lce'i rnam par shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa yang yongs su shes

pa myed/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sa'i khams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ chu'i khams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ mye'i khams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rlung gi khams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ nam mkha'i khams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rnam par shes pa'i khams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ ma rig pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'du byed kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rnam par shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ mying dang gzugs kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ skye mched drug kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ reg pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ tshor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sred pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ len pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ srid pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ skye ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ rga shi yang yongs su shes pa

myed/ blang ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ dor ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ bsam gtan dang po yang yongs su shes pa myed/ bsam gtan gnyis pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ bsam gtan gsum pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ bsam gtan bzhi pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ byams pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ snying rje yang yongs su shes pa myed/ dga' ba yang yongs su shes pa myed/ btang snyoms kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ chos rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ dge 'dun rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ tshul khrims rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ gtong ba rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lha rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ skyo ba rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'chi ba rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lus kyi rnam pa rjes su dran pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ myi rtag pa'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ bdag myed pa'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ myi sdug pa'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ bdag gi 'du shes

kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ sems can gyi 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ srog gi 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ skye ba'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ gso ba'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ skyes bu'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ gang zag gi 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ shed can gyi 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ shed bdag gi 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ byed pa po'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ tshor ba po'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ shes pa po'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ mthong ba po'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rtag pa'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ bde ba'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ sdug pa'i 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ bdag gi 'du shes kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ dbang po rnams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ stobs rnams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ lam yang yongs su shes pa myed/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rnam par thar pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rtog pa dang bcas dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang yongs su

shes pa myed/ rtog pa myed la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rtog pa myed cing dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lam 'phags pa'i bden pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ kun 'byung ba shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'gog pa shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lam shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ zad pa shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ myi skye ba shes pa yang yongs su shes pa med/ chos shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ rjes su 'gro ba shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ kun rdzob shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'dris pa shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sgra ji bzhin shes pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang yongs su shes pa myed/ nang stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ phyi stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ phyi nang stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa

myed/ chen po stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ mngon par shes pa drug kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ gzungs kyi sgo thams cad kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yang yongs su shes pa myed/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi yang yongs su shes pa myed/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yang yongs su shes pa myed/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ byams pa chen po yang yongs su shes pa myed/ snying rje chen po yang yongs su shes pa myed/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang yongs su shes pa myed/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang yongs su shes pa myed/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang yongs su shes pa myed/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ rang byang chub kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang yongs su shes pa myed/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spang ba yang yongs su shes pa myed na/ de thar bar 'gyur ba lta ga las 'ong / gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ dngos po mchis zhes bgyi ba ni ji lags/ dngos po ma mchis zhes bgyi ba ni ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gnyis ni dngos po yod pa'o/ /myi gnyis pa ni dngos po myed pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gnyis shes bgyi ba ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /tshor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'du byed kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myig gi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rna ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sna'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lce'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lus kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /yid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /gzugs kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sgra'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dri'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /ro'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /reg gi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /chos kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lce'i

'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sa'i khams kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /chu'i khams kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /mye'i khams kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rlung gi khams kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /ma rig pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'du byed kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rnam par shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /mying dang gzugs kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /skye mched drug gi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /reg pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /tshor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sred pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /len pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /srid pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /skye ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rga shi'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /blang ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dor ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bsam gtan dang po'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bsam gtan gsum pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /byams pa'i 'du

shes ni gnyis so/ /snying rje'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dga' ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /btang snyoms kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /chos rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /tshul khrims rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /gtong ba rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lha rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /skyo ba rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'chi ba rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lus kyi rnam pa rjes su dran pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myi rtag pa'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bdag myed pa'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myi sdug pa'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bdag gi 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sems can gyi 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /srog gi 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /skye ba'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /gso ba'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /skyes bu'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /gang zag gi 'du shes kyi

'du shes ni gnyis so/ /shed can gyi 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /shed bdag gi 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /byed pa po'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /tshor ba po'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /shes pa po'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /mthong ba po'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rtag pa'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bde ba'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sdug pa'i 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bdag gi 'du shes kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /yang dag par spong ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dbang po'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /stobs kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag gi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lam gyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rnam par thar pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rtog pa dang bcas dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rtog pa myed la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rtog pa myed cing dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'i 'du

shes ni gnyis so/ /sdug bsngal shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /kun 'byung ba shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'gog pa shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lam shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /zad pa shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myi skye ba shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /chos shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rjes su 'gro ba shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /kun rdzob shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'dris pa shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sgra ji bzhin shes pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /nang stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /phyi stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /chen po stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi

'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /mngon par shes pa drug gi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /myi 'jigs pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /byams pa chen po'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /snying rje chen po'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rang byang chub kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /dgra bcom pa'i 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'dus byas kyi khams kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /'dus ma byas kyi khams kyi 'du shes ni gnyis so/ /rab 'byor de ltar de snyed du 'du shes dang bcas pa thams cad dang / ji snyed du 'du shes myed pa de dag thams cad ni gnyis te/ ji tsam du gnyis pa de tsam du dngos po'o/ /ji tsam du dngos po yod pa de tsam du 'khor

ba'o/ /ji tsam du 'khor ba de tsam du sems can rnams skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid myi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa las yongs su myi 'grol lo/ /'du shes thams cad yid la myi byed pa ni gnyis su myed pa ste/ rab 'byor rnam grangs des kyang 'di ltar gnyis kyi 'du shes can la sbyin pa myed pa dang / gnyis kyi 'du shes can la tshul khrims myed pa dang / gnyis kyi 'du shes can la bzod pa myed pa dang / gnyis kyi 'du shes can la brtson 'grus myed pa dang / gnyis kyi 'du shes can la bsam gtan myed pa dang / gnyis kyi 'du shes can la shes rab myed pa dang / gnyis kyi 'du shes can la lam myed pa dang / gnyis kyi 'du shes can la 'thob pa myed pa dang / gnyis kyi 'du shes can la mngon par rtogs pa med par rig par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gnyis kyi 'du shes can la ni chung ngu na mthun pa'i bzod pa yang myed na/ gzugs yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'du byed yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam par shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myig yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rna ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sna yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lce yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gzugs yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sgra yongs su shes

par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dri yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ro yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ reg yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chos yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myig gi rnam par shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sna'i rnam par shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lce'i rnam par shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la

yod/ sa'i khams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chu'i khams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mye'i khams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rlung gi khams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ nam mkha'i khams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam par shes pa'i khams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ma rig pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'du byed yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam par shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mying dang gzugs yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ skye mched drug yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ reg pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sred pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ len pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ srid pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ skye ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rga shi yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ blang ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dor ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bsam gtan dang po yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bsam gtan gnyis pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bsam gtan gsum pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bsam gtan bzhi pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ byams pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la

yod/ snying rje yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dga' ba yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ btang snyoms yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chung zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chos rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dge 'dun rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshul khrims rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gtong ba rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lha rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ skyo ba rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'chi ba rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lus kyi rnam pa rjes su dran pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myi rtag pa'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sdug bsngal gyi 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bdag myed pa'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myi sdug pa'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes yongs su shes

par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bdag gi 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sems can gyi 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ srog gi 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ skye ba'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gso ba'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ skyes bu'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gang zag gi 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ shed can gyi 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ shed bdag gi 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ byed pa po'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshor ba po'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ shes pa po'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mthong ba po'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rtag pa'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bde ba'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sdug pa'i 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bdag gi 'du shes yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ yang dag par spong ba rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dbang po rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ stobs rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/

lam yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mtshan ma myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam par thar pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rtog pa dang bcas dpyod pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rtog pa myed la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rtog pa myed cing dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ kun 'byung ba 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lam 'phags pa'i bden pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sdug bsngal shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ kun 'byung ba shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'gog pa shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lam shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ zad pa shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myi skye ba shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chos shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rjes su 'gro ba shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ kun rdzob shes

pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'dris pa shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sgra ji bzhin shes pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ nang stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ phyi stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chen po stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/

rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ mngon par shes pa drug yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ gzungs kyi sgo thams cad yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ myi 'jigs pa rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ byams pa chen po yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ snying rje chen po yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ dgra bcom pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rang byang chub yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su shes par 'gyur ba lta ga la yod de/ gang la lam bsgom pa myed pa de la/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yang ga la yod/ lan cig phyir 'ong

ba'i 'bras bu yang ga la yod/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang ga la yod/ dgra bcom pa nyid kyang ga la yod/ rang byang chub kyang ga la yod/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang ga la yod/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang ga la yod/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa yang ga la yod/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u lnga bcu dgu'o/ /// /de nas tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar dngos po'i 'du shes can la mthun pa'i bzod pa yang ma mchis pas/ 'thob pa lta ga la mchis te ma mchis/ mngon par rtogs pa lta yang ga la mchis te/ ma mchis na ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das dngos po ma mchis pa'i 'du shes can la mthun pa'i bzod pa'am/ dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa'am/ rigs kyi sa 'am/ brgyad pa'i sa'am/ mthong ba'i sa 'am/ bsrabs pa'i sa'am/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa'am/ byas pa rtogs pa'i sa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi sa 'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi sa 'am/ lam bsgom pa gang la brten cing / nyon mongs pa gang gis bsgribs pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon ma mchis par chud par myi 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon ma mchis par ma chud pas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par myi 'gyur ba dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma thob pas/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad mi spongs pa'i sgrib pa nyan thos dang ldan pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas

dang ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa de dag spong bar 'gyur ba'i lam mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das gal te chos skye bar 'gyur ba gang yang skye ba ma mchis na ji ltar chos de dag ma skyes par rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byord de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la mthun pa'i bzod pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la mngon par rtogs pa'i sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la dkar po rnam par mthong ba'i sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la rigs kyi sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la brgyad pa'i sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la mthong ba'i sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la bsrabs pa'i sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la byas pa rtogs pa'i sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la rang sangs rgyas kyi sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la byang chub sems dpa'i sa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la sangs rgyas kyi sa med do/ /dngos po myed pa'i 'du shes can la lam bsgom pa gang la brten cing nyon mongs pa gang gis bsgribs pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par chud par myi 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par ma chud pas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par myi 'gyur ba dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma thob pas/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad myi spong ba'i sgrib pa/ nyan thos

dang ldan pa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas dang ldan pa'i nyon mongs pa de dag spong bar 'gyur ba'i lam myed do/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ dngos po mchis par 'du shes pa dang / dngos po ma mchis par 'du shes pa mchis sam/ gzugs su 'du shes pa dang / tshor bar 'du shes pa dang / 'du shes su 'du shes pa dang / 'du byed du 'du shes pa dang / rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dang / myig du 'du shes pa dang / rna bar 'du shes pa dang / snar 'du shes pa dang / lcer 'du shes pa dang / lus su 'du shes pa dang / yid du 'du shes pa dang / gzugs su 'du shes pa dang / sgrar 'du shes pa dang / drir 'du shes pa dang / ror 'du shes pa dang / reg du 'du shes pa dang / chos su 'du shes pa dang / myig gi rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg par 'du shes pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg par 'du shes pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg par 'du shes pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg par 'du shes pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg par 'du shes pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg par 'du shes pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor bar 'du shes pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes pa dang / lce'i 'dus te

reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bar 'du shes pa dang / sa'i khams su 'du shes pa dang / chu'i khams su 'du shes pa dang / mye'i khams su 'du shes pa dang / rlung gi khams su 'du shes pa dang / nam mkha'i khams su 'du shes pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams su 'du shes pa dang / 'dod chags su 'du shes pa dang / 'dod chags spang bar 'du shes pa dang / zhe sdang du 'du shes pa dang / zhe sdang spang bar 'du shes pa dang / gti mug tu 'du shes pa dang / gti mug spang bar 'du shes pa dang / ma rig par 'du shes pa dang / ma rig pa spang bar 'du shes pa dang / 'du byed du 'du shes pa dang / 'du byed spang bar 'du shes pa dang / rnam par shes par 'du shes pa dang / rnam par shes pa spang bar 'du shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs su 'du shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs spang bar 'du shes pa dang / skye mched drug tu 'du shes pa dang / skye mched drug spang bar 'du shes pa dang / reg par 'du shes pa dang / reg pa spang bar 'du shes pa dang / tshor bar 'du shes pa dang / tshor ba spang bar 'du shes pa dang / sred par 'du shes pa dang / sred pa spang bar 'du shes pa dang / len par 'du shes pa dang / len pa spang bar 'du shes pa dang / srid par 'du shes pa dang / srid pa spang bar 'du shes pa dang / skye bar 'du shes pa dang / skye ba spang bar 'du shes pa dang / rga shir 'du shes pa dang / rga shi spang bar 'du shes pa dang / mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don par 'du shes pa dang / mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa spang bar 'du shes pa dang / sdug

bsngal ba dang / yid myi bde bar 'du shes pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid myi bde ba spang bar 'du shes pa dang / 'khrug par 'du shes pa dang / 'khrug pa spang bar 'du shes pa dang / sdug bsngal du 'du shes pa dang / sdug bsngal kun shes par bya bar 'du shes pa dang / kun 'byung bar 'du shes pa dang / kun 'byung ba spang bar 'du shes pa dang / 'gog par 'du shes pa dang / 'gog pa mngon du bya bar 'du shes pa dang / lam du 'du shes pa dang / lam bsgom par 'du shes pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'du shes pa dang / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spang bar 'du shes pa'i bar du mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni myed do/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ chos gang la yang dngos po yod par 'du shes pa 'am/ dngos po myed par 'du shes pa myed do/ /gang la dngos po yod par 'du shes pa dang / dngos po myed par 'du shes pa myed pa de nyid ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i mthun pa'i bzod pa'o/ /gang la dngos po yod par 'du shes pa dang / dngos po myed par 'du shes pa myed pa de nyid ni lam bsgom pa'o/ /gang la dngos po yod par 'du shes pa dang / dngos po myed par 'du shes pa myed pa de nyid ni 'bras bu'o/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i lam ni dngos po myed pa ste/ mngon par rtogs pa yang dngos po myed pa'o/ /rab 'byor de ltar rnam grangs des kyang 'di ltar chos thams cad ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid du rig par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar chos

thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pas/ chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur te/ /de dag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pas/ chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i yul la/ mnga' brnyes par gyur/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rab 'byor 'di la nga sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod cing / pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa'i tshe/ 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa rtog pa dang bcas pa dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /rnam par rtog pa dang rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas/ nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rtog pa myed pa dpyod pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can/ bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas/ dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms la gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong zhing 'phags pa rnams kyis dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par dpyod pa btang snyoms pa'o/ /zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bde ba yang spangs sdug bsngal ba yang spangs shing / snga ma'i yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas kyang nub pas bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa/ btang snyoms dang dran pas yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs shing gnas par gyur te/ 'on kyang ngas bsam

gtan 'di dag dang / bsam gtan gyi yan lag de dag gi mtshan ma bzung ste/ bsam gtan de dag gis bsnyems par ma gyur/ bsam gtan gyi ro myong bar ma gyur/ bsam gtan du dmyigs par ma gyur te/ de ltar na ngas bsam gtan de dag rnam pa yongs su dag pa la mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar na ngas bsam gtan de dag rnam par smin par byas nas/ shes pa rnam pa tha dad pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sems gzhol bar byas/ lha'i rna ba'i shes pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sems gzhol bar byas/ pha rol gyi sems shes pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sems gzhol bar byas/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa shes pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sems gzhol bar byas/ lha'i myig gi shes pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir sems gzhol bar byas/ 'on kyang ngas mngon par shes pa mngon du bya ba de dag la mtshan mar bzung ste/ mngon par shes pa de dag gis shes par ma gyur/ ro myong bar ma gyur dmyigs par ma gyur te/ mngon par shes pa lnga po de dag nam mkha' lta bur yang dag par rjes su dran pas mnyam par gzhag ste/ de ltar ngas skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ 'di ni sdug bsngal lo/ /'di ni sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam mo/ /zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su shes par gyur te/ de ltar nga de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ldan par gyur/ myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang ldan par gyur/ byams

pa chen po dang ldan par gyur/ snying rje chen po dang ldan par gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang ldan par gyur nas/ sems can rnams phung po gsum du lung bstan par gyur to/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi bsam gtan bzhi bskyed par gyur/ ji ltar dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi mngon par shes pa drug bskyed par gyur/ ji ltar dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bskyed par gyur/ ji ltar dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi myi 'jigs pa bzhi bskyed par gyur/ ji ltar dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi bskyed par gyur/ ji ltar dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi byams pa chen po bskyed par gyur/ ji ltar dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi snying rje chen po bskyed par gyur/ ji ltar dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad bskyed par gyur/ sems can rnams kyang sems can ma mchis par ji ltar phung po gsum du lung bstan par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gal te 'dod pa rnams dang sdig to myi dge ba'i chos rnams la dngos po zhig yod de/ ngo bo nyid yod pa 'am/ gzhan gyi dngos po zhig yod na ni/ rab 'byor ngas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ 'dod pa rnams dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / sdig to myi dge ba'i chos rnams dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid du rig nas/ bsam gtan bzhi nye bar bsgrubs te gnas par yang myi 'gyur te/ rab 'byor 'di ltar 'dod pa rnams dang / sdig

to myi dge ba'i chos rnams la dngos po myed pa/ ngo bo nyid myed pa/ rang gi dngos po myed pa/ gzhan gyi dngos po myed pa ste/ gzhan du na dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pas/ rab 'byor de'i phyir nga sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ 'dod pas dben sdig to myi dge ba'i chos kyis dben pa rtog pa dang bcas pa dpyod pa dang bcas pa dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas par gyur to/ /rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa nye bar zhi nas/ nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas/ rtog pa myed pa dpyod pa myed pa ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang / bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas par gyur to/ /dga' ba las 'dod chags dang bral bas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin du btang snyoms la gnas te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la 'phags pa rnams kyis dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la rnam par spyod pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba myed pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas par gyur to/ /bde ba yang spangs/ sdug bsngal yang spangs shing / yid bde ba dang / yid myi bde ba snga nas nub pas/ bde ba yang myed/ sdug bsngal yang myed pa btang snyoms dang dran pas/ yongs su dag pa'i bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas par gyur to/ /rab 'byor gal te mngon par shes pa rnams la dngos po zhig yod de/ ngo bo nyid yod pa 'am/ rang gi dngos po yod pa 'am/ gzhan gyi dngos po zhig yod na ni/ rab 'byor ngas kyang mngon par shes pa thams cad dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid du rig nas/ bla na myed pa yang

dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par myi 'gyur te/ rab 'byor 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams la dngos po myed de/ ngo bo nyid myed pa gzhan gyi dngos po myed pa ste/ gzhan du na dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pas/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mngon par shes pa thams cad dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid du thugs su chud de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gal te de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid la bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lngas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya na/ bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du/ chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mthar kyis spyod pa dang / mthar kyis slob pa dang / mthar kyis nan tan du bgyi ba gang gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i mthar kyis spyod pa dang / mthar kyis slob pa dang / mthar kyis nan tan du bgyi ba mchis par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ thog mar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dag dang / sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur ba'i dgra

bcom pa dag dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa dag las/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / phyir myi 'ong ba rnams dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / 'phags pa thams cad dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / 'du byed rnams kyi ngo bo nyid chung ngu na skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas kyi gnas tsam yang myed do/ /zhes bya bar thos na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des ji ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid/ dgra bcom pa rnams kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid/ phyir myi 'ong ba rnams kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid/ rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyang dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid yin na/ gal te bdag bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyang rung / gal te mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas kyang rung ste/ chos thams cad ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid yin gyis/ ci nas kyang bdag bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byas te/

sems can dngos po'i 'du shes can la spyod pa thams cad dngos po myed pa la rab tu dgod par bya'o snyam ste/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba'i phyir/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'jug ste/ mthar kyis spyod pa dang / mthar kyis bslab pa dang / mthar kyis nan tan du bya ba gang la bslabs shing / sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par gyur pa de lta bu'i mthar kyis spyod pa dang / mthar kyis bslab pa dang / mthar kyis nan tan du rtsom mo/ /de thog mar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / pha rol tu phyind pa drug la spyod do/ /de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bdag kyang sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /pha rol kyang sbyin pa la rab tu gzhog go /sbyin pa'i legs pa rjod do/ /sems can gzhan gang sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba de dag gi yang legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar spyod do/ /de sbyin pa des skyid pa chen po'i tshogs thob par 'gyur te/ skyon dang / ser sna myed pa'i sems kyis sbyin pa sbyin par bya ba dang / sbyin pa yongs su gtong bar byed de/ zas 'dod pa la ni zas/ skom 'dod pa la ni skom/ bzhon pa 'dod pa la ni bzhon pa/ gos 'dod pa la ni gos/ spos 'dod pa la ni spos/ phreng ba 'dod pa la ni phreng ba/ byug pa 'dod pa la ni byug

pa/ mal ca 'dod pa la ni mal ca/ gnas 'dod pa la ni gnas/ mar mye 'dod pa la ni mar me/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūrya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / gser dang / dngul 'dod pa rnams la ni/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai ḍūrya dang / dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / gser dang / dngul yongs su gtong ba nas/ myi'i yo byad gang ci yang rung ba dag kyang / de dag la gtong ba'i bar du ste/ de sbyin pa de nyid kyis tshul khrims kyi phung po yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /lha'i che ba nyid rab tu thob par byed do/ /myi'i che ba nyid rab tu thob par byed do/ /de sbyin pa dang tshul khrims de nyid kyis/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po rab tu thob par byed do/ /de sbyin pa dang tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin de nyid kyis/ shes rab kyi phung po rab tu thob par byed do/ /de sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab de nyid kyis/ rnam par grol ba'i phung po rab tu thob par byed do/ /de sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba de nyid kyis rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po rab tu thob par byed do/ /de sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba de nyid kyis/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas/ sems can rnams yongs su smyin par byas nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas/ chos kyi

'khor lo skor ro/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ sems can rnams theg pa gsum la so sor 'god cing / 'khor ba las yongs su grol bar byed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sbyin pas mthar kyis spyod pa yod pa yin te/ de thams cad kyang dmyigs su myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de la ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ bdag kyang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gzhan yang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i legs pa rjod do/ /gzhan tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de dag gi yang legs pa rjod cing / mthun pas dga' bar spyod do/ /de tshul khrims des lha'i che ba nyid rab tu thob par byed do/ /myi'i che ba nyid rab tu thob par byed do/ /de nor myed pa'i sems can rnams la nor byin zhing / tshul khrims la rab tu 'god do/ /ting nge 'dzin la rab tu 'god do/ /shes rab la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba la rab tu 'god do/ /de tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po des nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das nas/ tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po de nyid kyis/ byang chub sems

dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas/ sems can rnams yongs su smyin par byas nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ro/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ sems can rnams theg pa gsum la so sor 'god cing / 'khor ba las yongs su grol bar byed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims kyis mthar kyis spyod pa yod pa yin te/ de thams cad kyang dmyigs su myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de la ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ bdag kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do/ /gzhan yang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par skul lo/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i legs pa rjod do/ /gzhan bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de dag gi yang legs pa rjod cing / mthun pas dga' bar spyod do/ /de bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can rnams sbyin pas yongs su tshim par byed do/ /tshul khrims la rab tu 'god do/ /ting nge 'dzin la rab tu 'god do/ shes rab la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba la rab tu 'god do/ /de tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po des/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das nas/

tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po de nyid kyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ro/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ sems can rnams theg pa gsum la so sor 'god cing / 'khor ba las yongs su grol bar byed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pas mthar kyis spyod pa yod pa yin te/ de thams cad kyang dmyigs su myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de la ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ bdag kyang dge ba'i chos rnams la brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /gzhan yang brtson 'grus la yang dag par skul lo/ /brtson 'grus kyi legs pa rjod do/ /gzhan brtson 'grus rtsom pa de dag gi yang legs pa rjod cing / mthun pas dga' bar spyod do/ /de brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / sems can rnams sbyin pas yongs su tshim par byed do/ /tshul khrims la rab tu 'god do/ /ting nge 'dzin la rab tu 'god do/ /shes rab la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba la rab tu 'god do/ /de tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi

phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po des nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis las 'das nas/ tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po de nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ro/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ sems can rnams theg pa gsum la so sor 'god cing / 'khor ba las yongs su grol bar byed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ brtson 'grus kyis mthar kyis spyod pa yod pa yin te/ de thams cad kyang dmyigs su myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de la ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ bdag kyang tshad myed pa dang / bsam gtan dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog go /gzhan yang tshad myed pa dang / bsam gtan dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la rab tu 'god do/ /tshad myed pa dang / bsam gtan dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi legs pa rjod do/ /gzhan tshad myed pa dang / bsam gtan dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la mnyam par gzhog pa de dag gi legs

pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar spyod do/ /de tshad myed pa dang / bsam gtan dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dag la gnas shing / sems can rnams sbyin pas yongs su tshim par byed do/ /tshul khrims la rab tu 'god do/ /ting nge 'dzin la rab tu 'god do/ /shes rab la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba la rab tu 'god do/ /de tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po des nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das nas/ tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po de nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor ro/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ sems can rnams theg pa gsum la so sor 'god cing 'khor ba las yongs su grol bar byed do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam gtan gyis mthar kyis spyod pa yod pa yin te/ de thams cad kyang dmyigs su myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de la ngo bo nyid myed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ sems

can rnams sbyin pas yongs su tshim par byed do/ /tshul khrims la rab tu 'god do/ /ting nge 'dzin la rab tu 'god do/ /shes rab la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba la rab tu 'god do/ /rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba la rab tu 'god do/ /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ bdag kyang sbyin pa yongs su gtong ngo / /tshul khrims srung ngo / /bzod pa sgrub bo/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /bsam gtan la mnyam par gzhog go/ /shes rab sgom mo/ /gzhan yang sbyin pa la rab tu gzhog go /tshul khrims la rab tu gzhog go /bzod pa la rab tu gzhog go /brtson 'grus la rab tu gzhog go /ting nge 'dzin la rab tu gzhog go /shes rab la rab tu gzhog go/ sbyin pa'i legs pa rjod do/ /tshul khrims kyi legs pa rjod do/ /bzod pa'i legs pa rjod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi legs pa rjod do/ /bsam gtan gyi legs pa rjod do/ shes rab kyi legs pa rjod do/ /gang gzhan sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba dang / tshul khrims srung ba dang / bzod pa sgrub pa dang / brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / bsam gtan la mnyam par gzhog pa dang / shes rab sgom pa de dag gi yang legs pa rjod cing mthun pas dga' bar spyod do/ /de sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de dang thabs mkhas pas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas/ sems can rnams yongs su
