nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /dbang po rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /stobs rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /bsam gtan rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /tshad myed pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rnam par thar pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /byams pa chen po mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /snying rje chen po mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mtshan

nyid myed par shes so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /dgra bcom pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rang byang chub mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtshan nyid myed par shes so/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rmi lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgyu ma lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ smig rgyu lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ chu zla lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ myig yor lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ gzugs brnyan lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de yang nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga rmi lam lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sgyu ma lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga smig rgyu lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga chu zla lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga myig yor lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sgra brnyan lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga gzugs brnyan lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga dri za'i grong khyer lta bur shes/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sprul pa lta bur shes nas/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed pa/ ma zhig pa/ ma ral ba/ skyon myed pa/ rnyog pa myed pa/ nyams pa

myed pa/ dbang du gyur pa/ mkhas pas bsngags pa/ shin tu rdzogs pa/ 'phags par gyur pa/ zag pa myed pa/ lam gyi khongs su chud pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa/ yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la gnas shing yang dag par blang ba'i brda dang ldan pa'i tshul khrims dang / chos nyid kyis thob pa'i tshul khrims dang / sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dmyigs pa'i tshul khrims dang / spyad pa'i tshul khrims dang / myi spyad pa'i tshul khrims srung ngo / /de tshul khrims de lta bu dang ldan yang 'dis bdag rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'i rigs dang skal ba mnyam pa 'am/ bram ze che zhing mtho ba'i rigs dang skal ba mnyam pa 'am/ khyim bdag che zhing mtho ba'i rigs dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar bya'o zhe 'am/ rgyal phran nam/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur bar bya'o zhe'am/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar bya'o zhe ba'am/ sum cu rtsa gsum mam/ mtshe ma 'am/ dga' ldan nam/ 'phrul dga' 'am/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam par skye bar bya'o zhe 'am/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par bya'o zhe 'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/ byang chub thob par bya'o zhes tshul khrims des snyems pa myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar chos thams cad ni mtshan nyid myed pa ste/ 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mtshan nyid gcig pas na mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos kyis mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos thob par myi rung ngo / /mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i chos kyis kyang mtshan nyid tha dad pa'i chos thob par myi rung ngo / /mtshan nyid tha dad pa 'am/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos kyis kyang / mtshan nyid tha dad pa 'am/ mtshan nyid

myed pa'i chos thob par myi rung ngo / /rab 'byor de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan nyid myed pa yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug pa'i tshe/ myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 'thob ste/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la spyod pa'i tshe/ rnam par smin pa las byung ba'i mngon par shes pa lnga rab tu thob nas/ gzungs kyi sgo lnga brgya dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo lnga brgya la gnas te/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ste/ sems can rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su 'dzin to/ /de 'gro ba lnga'i 'khor ba na 'khor yang / 'khor ba'i las rnam par smin pas gos par myi 'gyur te/ 'di ltar dper na/ sprul pa ni 'gro ba 'am/ sdod pa 'am/ 'dug pa 'am/ nyal ba byed kyang de la 'gro ba 'am/ 'ong ba 'am/ sdod pa 'am/ 'dug pa 'am/ nyal ba yang myi dmyigs te/ de sems can rnams kyi don kyang byed do/ /sems can dang sems can du btags pa yang myi dmyigs so/ /rab 'byor 'di lta ste dper na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shin tu zhi ba zhes bya ba/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ sems can tshad myed pa theg pa gnyis kyis yongs su mya ngan las bzlas kyang gang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan par bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' de lta bu gang

yang ma gzigs nas/ des tshe'i 'du byed spangs nas sprul pa sprul pa mdzad de/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das so/ /rab 'byor de ltar sprul pa des bskal ba gcig lon nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung bstan te/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur to/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa de'i gzugs sam/ tshor ba 'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'am/ dngos po gang yang dmyigs su myed do/ /rab 'byor de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang sems can nam sems can du gdags pa yang myi dmyigs la/ sems can rnams kyi don yang byed do/ rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de yongs su rdzogs pas mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos thams cad khong du chud par shes so/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rmyi lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu dang / chu zla lta bu dang / myig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas te/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos rnams la gnas shing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa gnyis kyis/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa

yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ gnyis gang zhe na/ nyams su len pa'i bzod pa dang / chos khong du chud pa'i bzod pa'o/ /de la nyams su len pa'i bzod pa gang zhe na/ sems dang po bskyed pa nas nye bar bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la 'dug gi bar du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i drung du gal te sems can thams cad yang dang yang 'ongs shing gshe ba 'am/ myi snyan par brjod cing ma klas pa'i tshig brlang ba zer bar gyur tam/ rdo dbyug dang / mtshon chas brdegs sam/ btab kyang de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'dod pas/ sems bskyed pa 'ga' tsam yang 'khrug pa dang ldan pa 'am/ gnod sems dang ldan pa bskyed par myi bya ste/ phyir sems can de dag la kye ma/ sems can 'di dag ni nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis mnar ba ste/ 'di dag la bdag gis sdig to'i sems myi skyed kyi/ 'di ni bdag nyid kyis phung po dgrar gyur pa 'di rnams blangs pa'i lan to zhes de dag la lhag par snying rje bskyed par bya'o/ /byams pa dang ldan te/ snying rje bar gyur nas/ rnam pa de ltar rtog pa 'di ni nyams su len pa'i bzod pa zhes bya'o/ /de la chos khong du chud pa'i bzod pa gang zhe na/ sems can de dag kyang don dam par dmyigs su myed na/ bdag la gshe ba 'am/ myi snyan par brjod pa 'am/ ma klas pa'i tshig brlang po zer ba 'am/ rdo dbyug gis brdeg cing mtshon 'debs pa lta su zhig yod de/ 'du byed thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu gsob gsog rag lus pa/ nam mkha' lta bu bdag dang sems can dang /

srog dang / 'gro ba dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang / gang zag dang / shed can dang / shed bdag dang / bral ba ste/ rnam par rtog pa de dag thams cad ni yongs su rtog pa las byung ba yin na/ bdag la gshe ba dang / myi snyan par brjod pa dang / ma klas pa'i tshig brlang par zer pa dang / rdo dbyug gis rdeg cing mtshon 'debs pa lta su zhig yod do/ bdag gis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid nye bar bzung ste/ de ltar rnam par brtag par myi bya'o zhes bya ba 'di ni chos khong du chud pa'i bzod pa zhes bya ste/ de de ltar yongs su rtog cing / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa des myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 'thob bo/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa zhes bgyi ba ni gang lags/ de la spangs pa ni ci mchis/ ye shes ni ci mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor chos gang la rdul tsam yang skye ba myed pa de ni myi skye ba'o/ /de gang gis shes pa de ni bzod pa zhes bya ste/ shes pa des myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 'thob bo/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa gang lags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i myi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa gang lags pa'i bzod pa de dag la bye brag tu bgyi ba ci mchis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor rgyun tu zhugs pa'i shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang ba gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i

bzod pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang ba gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang ba gang yin pa de ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa'i shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang ba gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa'o/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi shes pa gang yin pa dang / spang ba gang yin pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i bzod pa ste/ rab 'byor de ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi bzod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa'i bye brag yin no/ /rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni bzod pa de lta bu dang ldan pas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad zil kyis gnon te/ de rnam par smin pa las byung pa'i myi skye ba'i chos kyi bzod pa la gnas te/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam la spyod cing / lam gyi rnam par shes pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de yongs su rdzogs pas/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams dang myi 'bral ba yin/ de mngon par shes pa lnga dang myi 'bral ba yin/ de mngon par shes pa rnams dang myi 'bral bas/ sems can rnams yongs su smin par byed pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed pa yin/ de sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas nas/ skad cig gcig dang ldan

pa'i shes rab kyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par byed de/ rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rmi lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu dang / chu zla lta bu dang / myig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smyig rgyu lta bu dang / dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / lus dang sems kyi brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /de lus kyi brtson 'grus kyis rdzu 'phrul/ mngon par sgrub ste/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag tu song nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la bsnyen bkur byed cing / sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byed do/ /de lus kyi brtson 'grus des sems can rnams yongs su smin par byas nas/ theg pa gsum la 'dzud cing rab tu 'god do/ /rab 'byor de ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de sems kyi brtson 'grus zag pa myed pa/ lam gyi yan lag tu gyur pa/ lam gyi khongs su chud pas/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gang du dge ba'i chos thams cad 'di lta ste/ dran pa nye

bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad yongs su 'dus pa yongs su rdzogs par byed de/ de la spyod cing byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ de yongs su rdzogs pas/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spangs par 'gyur ro/ /bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba thams cad spangs nas/ mtshan phun sum tshogs pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /kun tu snang ba thob par byas nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa bcu gnyis rgyud gsum du bskor ba skor bar 'gyur ro/ de bskor bas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba dang / rab tu g.yo ba dang / kun nas g.yo pa dang / 'gul ba dang / rab tu 'gul ba dang / kun nas 'gul ba dang / ldeg pa dang / rab tu ldeg pa dang / kun nas ldeg par 'gyur te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang snang ba chen pos rgyas par

gang bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i sgra gang du byung zhing dbyangs grag par gyur pa'i sgra de stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can gang ji snyed kyis thos pa de/ thams cad theg pa gsum la nges par 'gyur te/ rab 'byor de ltar phan pa chen po dang ldan pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnas te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya'o/ /rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rmyi lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu dang / myig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / chu zla lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /rab 'byor ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa'i tshe/ rmi lam lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas/ sgra brnyan lta bu dang / myig yor lta bu dang / sgyu ma lta bu dang / smig rgyu lta bu dang / chu zla lta bu dang / sprul pa lta bu'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga la gnas shing / ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa yin zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan dang po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan gsum pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa la nye bar bsgrubs

te gnas so/ /byams pa la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /snying rje chen po la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /dga' ba la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /btang snyoms la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /chung zad myed pa'i skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched la nye bar bsgrubs te gnas so/ /stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /glog lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom mo/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ma gtogs par nyan thos dang thun mong ba'am/ rang sangs rgyas dang thun mong pa'i ting nge 'dzin gang ji snyed pa dang / gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshogs gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad lus kyis khyab par byas shing / nye bar bsgrubs te gnas kyang / ting nge 'dzin de dag dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i 'bras bu'i ro myong bar myi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des/ ting nge 'dzin de dag gi mtshan nyid myed pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid du shes pas na/ mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos mtshan nyid myed pa'i chos kyi ro myong bar byed par yang ga la 'gyur/ dngos po myed pa'i chos kyang dngos po myed pa'i chos kyi ro myong bar byed pa ga la 'gyur te/ de ro myong bar byed pa myed pas/ ting nge 'dzin gang gis dbang gis kyang gzugs kyi khams sam/ gzugs myed pa'i khams su skye bar myi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des khams de gnyis kyang myi dmyigs/ gang snyoms par 'jug pa dang / gang gis snyoms par 'jug pa de yang myi dmyigs so/ /de myi dmyigs pas mtshan nyid myed pa'i ting nge 'dzin

gyi pha rold tu phyind pa yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa des/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis las yongs su 'da'o/ /rab 'byor kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyis shing / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las yongs su 'da' ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor de ni 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos nang stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la shin tu bslabs pa'i phyir te/ stong pa nyid 'di dag la ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'am/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bam/ gang la gnas par bya ba'i chos de lta bu gang yang myi dmyigs te/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya ba de yang stong pa nyid rnams kyis stong ste/ stong pa nyid de dag gis byang chub

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyis las shin tu 'das nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug go /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i skyon ni gang lags/ skyon ma mchis pa ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor dmyigs pa thams cad ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i skyon no/ /myi dmyigs pa thams cad ni skyon myed pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dmyigs pa ni gang lags/ myi dmyigs pa ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rab 'byor gzugs ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor tshor ba ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'du shes ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor 'du byed ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rab 'byor rnam par shes pa ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /myig dang gzugs ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /rna ba dang sgra ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /sna dang dri ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /lce dang ro ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /lus dang reg bya ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /yid dang chos ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dmyigs pa'o/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rna ba'i 'dus te

reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sa'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /chu'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mye'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rlung gi khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /nam mkha'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /ma rig pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'du byed ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mying dang gzugs ni dmyigs pa'o/ /skye mched drug ni dmyigs pa'o/ /reg pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /tshor ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sred pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /len pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /srid pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /skye ba ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rga shi ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /phyi stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /phyi nang stong pa

nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dbang po rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /stobs rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /bsam gtan rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni dmyigs pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni dmyigs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi ni dmyigs pa'o/ /so so yang dag par

rig pa bzhi ni dmyigs pa'o/ /byams pa chen po ni dmyigs pa'o/ /snying rje chen po ni dmyigs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni dmyigs pa'o/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rang byang chub ni dmyigs pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni dmyigs pa'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni dmyigs pa ste skyon no/ /rab 'byor skyon myed pa ni gang la gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / myig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg dang / chos dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang / sa'i khams dang / chu'i khams dang / mye'i khams dang / rlung gi khams dang / nam mkha'i khams dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / ma rig pa dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / mying dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang / reg pa dang / tshor ba dang / sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang / skye ba dang / rga shi dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam

gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad myed pa rnams dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwo brgyad dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / chos de dag gi brjod pa yang dmyigs su myed pa'o// //
